phases.name: Build Config
transformations: Changed packaging from war to jar
Updated Java compiler version from 1.8 to 17
Added Quarkus BOM 3.2.9.Final
Added quarkus-maven-plugin with build goals
Removed javaee-web-api and javaee-api dependencies
Removed JBoss-specific dependencies (jboss-jms-api, jboss-rmi-api)
Removed maven-war-plugin
Added 6 Quarkus extensions: arc, resteasy-reactive-jackson, hibernate-orm-panache, jdbc-postgresql, flyway, smallrye-reactive-messaging-kafka
Preserved custom audit-logging-library as system-scoped dependency

phases.name: App Config
transformations: Created application.properties with datasource configuration (PostgreSQL)
Configured Hibernate ORM settings
Configured Flyway migration (migrate-at-start=true)
Configured Kafka messaging channels: orders and inventory
Configured HTTP port and logging settings

phases.name: EJB to CDI
transformations: Replaced @Stateless with @ApplicationScoped (6 services)
Replaced @Stateful with @SessionScoped + Serializable (1 service)
Replaced @EJB with @Inject
Removed @Remote and @Local annotations
Deleted ShippingServiceRemote interface
Replaced JNDI lookups with direct CDI injection in ShoppingCartService
Removed lookupShippingServiceRemote() method and WebLogic JNDI code
Batch-replaced all javax.* imports with jakarta.* across all Java files
Updated ShoppingCartOrderProcessor to use Kafka Emitter instead of JMS
Applied namespace migrations: persistence, inject, enterprise, ws.rs, annotation, transaction, xml.bind

phases.name: Messaging
transformations: Converted OrderServiceMDB from @MessageDriven to @ApplicationScoped + @Incoming('orders')
Replaced onMessage(Message) with processOrder(String) using reactive messaging
Removed all JMS imports and MessageListener interface
Converted InventoryNotificationMDB from manual JMS setup to @Incoming('inventory')
Removed WebLogic-specific JNDI lookups and connection factory code
Removed WebLogic T3 protocol configuration
Replaced JMS producer in ShoppingCartOrderProcessor with Kafka Emitter
Configured Kafka channels in application.properties

phases.name: Lifecycle

steps.description: Replace WebLogic lifecycle with Quarkus events

transformations: Replaced ApplicationLifecycleListener with @Observes StartupEvent and ShutdownEvent
Removed weblogic.application imports
Updated StartupListener to use Quarkus lifecycle events
Simplified DataBaseMigrationStartup (Flyway now handled by Quarkus extension)
Updated Producers and Transformers to jakarta.* namespace

phases.name: Cleanup

steps.description: Final verification - Check for remaining javax imports

transformations: Deleted legacy XML configuration files
Removed entire weblogic package stub directory
Verified all javax.* EE imports converted to jakarta.*
Confirmed no remaining Java EE or WebLogic dependencies
